caption:
A cup tips over on the bed and everyone panics.

Twin beds take the most spills — kids climbing up with juice, a dog on the covers, a late-night glass of water. Once liquid gets past the sheet it sits in the mattress itself, and by then wiping it up does nothing. Thicker mattresses make it worse because a regular sheet barely stretches over the corners, let alone anything underneath it.

This protector is waterproof and stretches over mattresses up to fifteen inches deep, so it actually reaches the corners instead of popping off. Over a hundred thousand people have rated it 4.5 stars.

One spill becomes a five minute wipe-down instead of a ruined mattress, and it runs about $13.
